name: VSTECS Berhad
summary: VSTECS Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the distribution of information and communications technology (ICT) products primarily in Malaysia. It operates through three segments: ICT Distribution, Enterprise Systems, and ICT Services. The company distributes notebooks, personal computers, smartphones, tablets, printers, wearables, software, network and communication infrastructure, servers, and enterprise software. It provides value-added product support and technical services. In addition, the company markets computers, peripherals, and software; and offers ICT systems and services, as well as computer maintenance services.
